order: P2 package, then stage-one materializer M2, then pure finalizer P2 r2, then stage-two adapter P2; each pins only the previous accepted hash

package.changeFromP1: Only the runner and the launcher are replaced, by the accepted SSH wiring candidates; the other 39 members are byte copies.

materializerM2.change: Anchored to P2; reads the bound SSH file through the accepted reader and compares the retained snapshot at every recheck.

pureFinalizerP2R2.change: Pins P2 and M2 and imports its helper modules from the P2 package.
pureFinalizerP2R2.rejectedRevision: r1 kept imports from the P1 package and was not accepted.

adapterP2.change: Authenticates the P2 closure before importing the P2 r2 finalizer; reads the bound SSH file through the accepted reader with snapshot rechecks.
adapterP2.reviews: No high or medium finding from the Opus auditor or the Fable reviewer.

limitations: Synthetic stage-one and admission inputs on NTFS with Node 24.19.0 only
The installed SSH binary was not read; the shared two-link profile was tested only through copies that change the fixed hash and size
Files are read again by module import after authentication, as in the earlier adapter
A change after the final SSH read is not detected
No private stage-one preparation, admission, GO or host step
